sections.Profile:
The "Skill-Ball" pinball machine, released by Williams Electronic Manufacturing Corporation in September 1961, is a single-player electro-mechanical game designed by Steve Kordek, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1961
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Circus, Magic, Clowns, Original Theme, Single level playfield
sections.Design Team:
- Art: George Molentin
- Design: Steve Kordek
sections.Editions:
- Skill-Ball: 650 made, released 1961-09-01, model number 263
- Add-A-Ball: released 1961-09-01, model number 263
